text.en: Clients frequently praise Imani Gordon for her calm demeanour, patience, and attentive attitude towards dogs and cats. Many pet parents note that she takes extra time to make nervous, elderly, or first-time pets feel relaxed before styling. Aside from one report regarding delayed responses, reviewers describe a warm and trustworthy grooming professional.

Reviewers emphasize how well pets respond to the gentle grooming approach, particularly dogs with anxiety or sensitivities to high-velocity dryers. Pet owners appreciate that the groomer works slowly and carefully to prevent distress. Clients report that their animals return home cheerful, relaxed, and completely free from grooming-related stress.

Owners praise the quality of haircuts, bath treatments, and sanitary trims for both dogs and cats. Clients note that coats are left fluffy, evenly styled, and pleasantly scented without overpowering perfumes. Multiple reviewers highlight careful attention to detail on delicate areas, including neatly trimmed paw pads and short, smooth nail trims.

q.en: Does Gordon Groom handle anxious or nervous dogs?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently mention that the groomer works patiently with shy or anxious animals.
Yes, reviewers confirm bringing cats for nail trims and grooming treatments.

q.en: Does the groomer send updates during the visit?

a.en: Clients report receiving helpful text messages and photos regarding their pets during appointments.

q.en: Can appointments be scheduled in advance?

a.en: Yes, clients typically book sessions in advance, though response times can occasionally fluctuate.
